name: utopia-pubdev
description: Compose and standardize pub.dev READMEs for Dart/Flutter packages - brand-profile-driven header and badge row, house voice, section structure, a no-sponsor footer with sibling links, and a tool-agnostic AI assistants section. Auto-applies the bundled Utopia profile in Utopia codebases, reads docs/pubdev-brand.md elsewhere, and ships a brand-setup interview skill plus the Utopia brand-chip header generator (package name to Clay PNG via headless Chrome).

interface.shortDescription: pub.dev README and branding standard for Dart/Flutter packages.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex through composing and standardizing pub.dev READMEs for Dart/Flutter packages: a brand-profile-driven header and badge row, house voice, minimal vs full section structure, a no-sponsor footer with sibling links, and a tool-agnostic AI assistants section. Auto-applies the bundled Utopia profile in Utopia codebases, reads docs/pubdev-brand.md elsewhere, and ships a brand-setup interview skill plus the Utopia brand-chip header generator (package name to Clay PNG via headless Chrome).
defaultPrompt: Write a pub.dev README for a package in this repo.
Refresh a package README to the house README standard.
Set up the pub.dev branding profile for this repo.
